Title: Rust Quests
Description: Four hidden traders live in secret train cabooses across the map, each with a chain of story quests that ends at a shared vault. Every wipe rolls a different storyline — and your call at the finale decides how the island treats you afterwards.
HowTo: Read the welcome note that lands in your pack when you first wake up.
Type /quest to open the journal — The Work tab shows who to find next.
Track down the hidden caboose shop and press E on the trader to talk.
Accept her quest, do the work, then return and claim the reward.
Finish all four chains, then make your call at the vault finale.
Notes: The story and shop locations reroll each wipe.
Building is blocked near a trader's shop.
